description: This bar chart, titled "Average Entropy Across Sycophancy Reduction Methods on Static Experiments," illustrates the average entropy values for three different sycophancy reduction methods—Baseline, Source Info, and Direct Command—as applied to three distinct AI models: GPT-4, Claude, and Llama. The horizontal axis, labeled "Different AI Models," presents the models in alphabetical order from left to right. The vertical axis, labeled "Entropy Average Values," is scaled linearly from 3.0 to 6.0, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.5. For each AI model, three bars are grouped side-by-side: a pink bar representing the Baseline method, a yellow bar for Source Info, and a light blue bar for Direct Command. The specific entropy values are as follows: for GPT-4, the Baseline is approximately 4.85, Source Info is approximately 5.25, and Direct Command is approximately 5.05; for Claude, Baseline is approximately 4.7, Source Info is approximately 5.1, and Direct Command is approximately 4.95; for Llama, Baseline is approximately 4.6, Source Info is approximately 4.95, and Direct Command is approximately 4.8. The bars are not sorted and are presented in the order of the AI models on the x-axis. There is no visual emphasis or annotation on any specific bar.
